title: Inspection.
officialText:
a.An authorized representative of the department may, consistent with applicable law and in accordance with rules of the department, enter a building or premises described in the notice of violation or request for corrective action and access any records of the owner related to unlawful conduct under this chapter to confirm that such violation has been corrected.

b.The commissioner may delegate to authorized monitors the authority to carry out inspections pursuant to this chapter or any rule promulgated pursuant thereto and report their findings to the department.

c.The cost of inspections pursuant to this chapter shall be paid by the owner.

(L.L. 2022/045, 1/15/2022, eff. 7/14/2022)
